Her mother beamed and responded "Certainly, Lily, we can use the needle together and repair your shirt." Together, they utilized the needle and sewed the button onto Lily's shirt. It wasn’t hard for them because they collaborated and supported one another. Once they completed their task, Lily expressed her gratitude to her mom for using the needle and mending her shirt. They both felt joyful because they had collaborated and achieved it together.
